Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Extend aligned repeated-color diagonals to the grid boundary. The
    # direction is determined by the existing pair's slope.
    for color in {v for row in grid for v in row}:
        if color == 9:
            continue
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        pairs = [(a, b) for i, a in enumerate(cells) for b in cells[i+1:]
                 if abs(a[0]-b[0]) == abs(a[1]-b[1]) and a != b]
        if not pairs:
            continue
        a, b = max(pairs, key=lambda p: abs(p[0][0]-p[1][0]))
        dr = 1 if b[0] > a[0] else -1
        dc = 1 if b[1] > a[1] else -1
        # Continue both ends; only background cells are drawn over.
        for r, c, sign in ((a[0], a[1], -1), (b[0], b[1], 1)):
            while 0 <= r + sign*dr < h and 0 <= c + sign*dc < w:
                r += sign*dr; c += sign*dc
                if out[r][c] == 9:
                    out[r][c] = color
                else:
                    break
    return out
